## What are you adding?

- [ ] A new **program** rule set (e.g. EITC, SSI/SSDI, CHIP, LIHEAP, …)
- [ ] A new **jurisdiction** (state/locality) for existing programs
- [ ] A correction to existing eligibility logic or a citation

## Program / jurisdiction

Name and the authority that governs it:

## Eligibility criteria

For each criterion, give the **controlling citation** (statute/regulation/policy) and a one-line description. Every criterion must be cited.

| criterion | required? | controlling citation (source + locator) | effective date |
|-----------|-----------|------------------------------------------|----------------|
|           |           |                                          |                |

## Thresholds / parameters

Income limits, AMI/FPL multipliers, time windows, expansion status, etc., and where they come from:

## Ambiguous edges

Which situations are genuinely close/ambiguous or state-dependent and should make TRIBUNE **abstain** rather than guess? (e.g. coverage gaps, good-cause determinations, closed waitlists, near-threshold income)

## Eligibility ≠ access

Are there access barriers (waitlists, funding caps) separate from eligibility that TRIBUNE must represent honestly?

## Domain reviewer

Eligibility logic needs review by someone with domain expertise (navigator, benefits counselor, legal-aid staff). Who can review this?

## Checklist

- [ ] No real PII anywhere in this issue
- [ ] Every rule claim has a verifiable citation
- [ ] Synthetic cases will cover clear-eligible, clear-ineligible, and ambiguous
